name: @pothos/plugin-prisma-next
description: Pothos integration for the Prisma ORM 8 SQL collection client

scripts.type: tsc --project tsconfig.type.json && tsc --project tsconfig.scope-auth.json && tsc --project tsconfig.missing-plugins.json && node tests/declarations/emit.mts tsc
scripts.type:compat: for v in 5.9.3 6.0.2; do for p in type scope-auth missing-plugins; do echo "typescript@$v tsconfig.$p.json" && pnpm dlx --package=typescript@$v tsc --project tsconfig.$p.json --noEmit --composite false --incremental false || exit 1; done; echo "typescript@$v declarations" && node tests/declarations/emit.mts pnpm dlx --package=typescript@$v tsc || exit 1; done
scripts.build: pnpm build:clean && pnpm build:cjs && pnpm build:dts && pnpm build:esm
scripts.build:esm: cp -r dts/* esm/ && swc src -d esm --config-file ../../.swcrc -C module.type=es6 --strip-leading-paths

author: Michael Hayes
